title: Database Failover Procedures
description: Database failover procedures for transaction processing systems
immediate_actions: Assess database health and replication status
Notify VertexPay DBA team before any changes
Prepare for database failover if necessary
Activate read-only mode if needed to prevent data corruption
investigation_steps: Review database error logs and performance metrics
resolution_steps: Execute database failover following approved procedures
Update application connection strings if needed
special_considerations: Do not modify transaction databases without approval from the VertexPay DBA team
Data integrity is critical for financial transactions
Coordinate with compliance team for audit requirements
Document all failover steps and timing
